description: Returns the official TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) tenders we monitor for submission-deadline changes, with each one's notice_id, last check time and freshness. Use it first to find a notice_id for tenders_list_deadline_changes; use awards_list_contracts for contract winners. No inputs. It does not add a watch (ask hello@aurelmark.live). Output: the watched notices with their notice_id values, last check times and freshness, as /v1/coverage reports them (checked hourly). Always free and unlimited, no key needed. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free, as short samples (up to 3 records, without file proof, history or paging cursor) where a paid HTTP address exists (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors are free, and so are empty answers except a sanctions name search with no match when every loaded list it checks is fresh (lists not loaded yet are named in the answer). An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.
name: tenders_list_watched
title: List watched TED tenders
